name: agentic-cr
description: Agentic code review for GitHub PRs — triages the diff to pick review lenses, fans them out as read-only finder agents, refutes their candidates with an adversarial verifier, and posts one consolidated comment. Two architectures: /cr (parallel subagents, needs a harness with subagent support) and /cr-single (one sequential agent, no subagents — installs with npx skills add and runs on pi, Codex, Cursor and any other Agent Skills harness; /cr hands the run over there when the session has no fan-out). Read-only by default; --fix also runs a finding-by-finding fix pass. Language- and project-agnostic.
